title: CAE Engineer / Analyst - EMC, EMI CAE
description:
**Role:**  

Vehicle EMC \& EMI CAE Simulation \& Evaluation
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

§ Prepare CAE models using HYPERMESH/ANSA – Mesh discretization, Assembly, Constraints \& Loads – for Automotive Sub\-systems \& Vehicles
  
  

§ System \& Full vehicle simulation for EMC / EMI performance using EMCoS Studio and EMCoS SimDAT softwares.
  
  

§ Conduct 3D electromagnetic field simulation for a wide range of applications including RF/Microwave design, optics and photonics, antenna design and installed performance, specific absorption rate (SAR), bio\-electromagnetics, co\-existence, de\-sense and interference, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), electromagnetic interference (EMI) and environmental effects (E3\), Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI)., Radiated Immunity (RI), Radiated Emissions (RE), Electro Static Discharge (ESD), Conducted Emissions (CE), Conducted Immunity (CI), and Transfer Impedance.
  
  

§ Interpretation of results, comprehend failure modes and provide directions for design countermeasures (Hardware / Software) by performing parameter studies on CAE model.
  
  

§ Report preparation and communication with stakeholders – design, testing – for implementation of countermeasures.
  
  

Interact with Testing teams for analyzing failures, correlation of CAE results with physical testing results and make improvements in CAE methodology.
  
  

Technical / Functional
  
  

:
  
  

§ Strong fundamentals of Electromagnetic theory, EMC/EMI principle, Signal \& Power Integrity (SI/PI)
  
  

§ Good knowledge of working (Hardware \& Software) of Automotive Sensors, Controllers, Electronics \& Electrical circuits.
  
  

§ Experience in electromagnetic field simulation in automotive domain at subsystem \& vehicle level, using analysis software \- EMCoS Studio and EMCoS SimDAT; Proficiency in data analysis using Matlab / Simulink.
  
  

§ Experience in conducting and evaluating tests in accordance with ISO 11451 series, ISO 11452 series, ISO 7637 series, ISO 10605, CISPR 12, CISPR 25, and CISPR 36\.
  
  

§ Experience in evaluation using RF measurement equipment such as network analyzers and spectrum analyzers.
  
  

§ Knowledge of wireless communication equipment (antenna fundamentals, transmission line fundamentals) and experience in design and/or measurement and evaluation.
  
  

iNARTE Engineer certification is preferred. Knowledge of Scripting (Python, VB) will be desired.
  
  

**Behavioral:**  

Excellent interpersonal skills, Communication \& presentation skills, Achievement orientation, Team player, Networking skills, Flexible

We work at the intersection of customer data, AI, and commercial impact, building products that turn insight into measurable growth.


**The Role**



The Senior Product Analyst plays a key role in helping us build better products through data\-driven decision making. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers, you'll transform complex product data into actionable insights that shape product strategy, improve user experiences and drive measurable business outcomes.



You'll champion product analytics across our product teams, enabling experimentation, establishing best practices and ensuring decisions are backed by meaningful data.

You'll combine analytical expertise, product knowledge and stakeholder collaboration to deliver insights that influence product direction and maximise customer value.


* Own product analytics across a portfolio of products, defining key metrics and ensuring they are measured, reported and understood effectively
* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Managers and Product Designers to support product strategy, objectives and key results (OKRs)

* Support product discovery, roadmap planning and experimentation by providing data\-driven insights and commercial context
* Leverage multiple data sources to identify trends, answer business questions and uncover new opportunities for product improvement
* Continuously improve analytics practices, reporting tools, data visualisation and automation to enable faster, more effective decision making
* Communicate insights clearly through compelling data visualisation and storytelling tailored to technical and non\-technical audiences

You'll bring strong analytical capability, curiosity and a passion for using data to solve product challenges while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.


* Experience in product analytics, product management, product ownership or a similar analytics\-focused role within a software or technology environment
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting complex data and translating findings into actionable business recommendations
* Experience working with cross\-functional product teams, including Product Managers, Engineers, Designers and Data Engineers
* Knowledge of product metrics, experimentation, performance measurement and product analytics best practices
* Experience building dashboards and communicating insights through effective data visualisation and storytelling

* Understanding of statistical analysis, product performance measurement and commercial drivers
* Experience on Heap,Fullstory or Amplitude

We won't just meet your expectations. We'll defy them. So you'll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you'd expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

title: Global People Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Senior Analyst, you’ll support evidenced\-based decision making. You’ll provide analytical input to support the Global People team and work with stakeholders across BCG. You’ll add a quantitative perspective to discussions on new and existing HR processes and procedures

  

You will apply an analytics mindset and empower internal clients with dashboards, data, and reports to help improve processes, and solve people related challenges, to provide thought leadership on the complete cycle of talent analytics, from sourcing the candidates to managing attrition

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, design, and manage advanced Tableau and Power BI dashboards that integrate data from diverse sources
* Use SQL to query databases and retrieve relevant data for analysis and reporting
  

Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) to create efficient and scalable data models
* Thought partner with internal stakeholders on various people related challenges, by developing domain expertise
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency through rigorous testing and quality checks
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and understand data sources

  

What You'll Bring

* Undergraduate degree, preferably in an engineering or other technology\-related fields, with high academic achievement required; advanced degree preferred
* MUST HAVES: 5\-7 years of full time Tableau and Power BI dashboard development, data modeling, and SQL language expertise
* Advanced Tableau experience, including Tableau server management, level of detail calculations, built custom charts, hyper data source, Javascript APIs
* Advanced Power BI skills, with a focus on dashboard development including DAX calculations, custom visualizations, and Power Query
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles for creating intuitive and visually impactful Tableau dashboards
* Knowledge in SQL for querying databases, optimizing data retrieval, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with skills in data manipulation, including sorting, filtering, and using formulas to analyze and organize complex data sets
* Background in HR data analysis and HR domain knowledge is preferred, however not mandatory
* Deep interest and aptitude in data, metrics, and analysis

  

Who You'll Work With

  

* As part of the Global People analytics team, you will modernize HR platforms, capabilities \& engagement, automate/digitize core HR processes and operations and enable greater efficiency. You will collaborate with the global people teams and colleagues across BCG to manage the life cycle of all BCG employees.
* The People Management Team (PMT) is comprised of several centers of expertise including HR Operations, People Analytics, Career Development, Learning \& Development, Talent Acquisition \& Branding, Compensation, and Mobility. Our centers of expertise work together to build out new teams and capabilities by sourcing, acquiring and retaining the best, diverse talent for BCG.
* We develop talent and capabilities, while enhancing managers’ effectiveness, and building affiliation and engagement in our global offices. The PMT also harmonizes process efficiencies, automation, and global standardization. Through analytics and digitalization, we are always looking to expand our PMT capabilities and coverage.

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Providing analytical support in metrics, reporting, and dashboard development
* Leading technical aspects of a large project with minimal supervision
* Generating insights from large and complex datasets, and understanding the nuances and inconsistencies in data
* Ability to multi\-task and operate effectively in a fast\-paced and customer\-oriented environment; ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a matrix organization
* Communicating and presenting technical details to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong interpersonal skills, who showcases credibility and excels in a collaborative setting


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Research Analyst IND
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


The Lead Research Analyst will support the Alternative Investments and Manager Research teams by performing investment data analysis, due diligence support, reporting, and operational research activities across both private and liquid alternative investment offerings. The role will partner closely with investment analysts and portfolio research professionals to support ongoing manager monitoring, research projects, investment onboarding activities, and various reporting initiatives.  

This position provides broad exposure to alternative investments, manager research processes, and investment due diligence activities across multiple asset classes. The analyst will have the opportunity to develop investment knowledge while supporting a wide range of research, reporting, and analytical functions for both private and liquid alternative investment strategies.**Key Responsibilities**

* Support quarterly and ongoing monitoring of alternative investment offerings by gathering, validating, and analyzing performance, asset, distribution, redemption, and portfolio\-level data.
* Prepare recurring research reports, dashboards, and analytical materials utilizing internal systems, FactSet, Morningstar, Preqin, Bloomberg, and other third\-party data sources.
* Assist with due diligence activities by reviewing offering documents, RFIs, marketing materials, and manager communications and extracting key information for analyst review.
* Coordinate and maintain investment research databases, due diligence records, SharePoint sites, and document repositories.
* Support manager onboarding, product review, and completion memo processes through data collection, drafting, and documentation.
* Assist with ad hoc analytical projects, including portfolio construction, holdings analyses, risk metrics, and other investment\-related research requests.
* Support recurring private alternatives reporting initiatives, including industry data gathering, performance benchmarking, and market intelligence reporting.
* Participate in manager meetings and introductory calls, documenting key discussion points and maintaining organized records of manager interactions.
* Coordinate the distribution, collection, and tracking of due diligence questionnaires, RFI responses, and related materials.
* Partner with investment research professionals across multiple manager research disciplines to support team initiatives and cross\-functional projects.

 **Required Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of relevant experience in investment research, due diligence, or alternative investments
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience), preferably in Finance, Economics, Investments, or related field
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage work independently and prioritize effectively
* Active Series 7 license or ability to obtain within 120 days

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated knowledge of alternative investment strategies and structures
* Prior experience conducting research on private markets (private equity, private credit, real assets)
* High attention to detail, strong ownership mindset, and intellectual curiosity
* Advanced quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to clearly communicate complex investment concepts
* CFA and/or CAIA designation, or an interest in pursuing one
